summary.title: A Basic React + Redux introductory tutorial
summary.one_liner: You learn the core React+Redux pieces (reducers, combineReducers, containers via connect, action creators, and Provider) by building a contact list that shows details on click.
keywords: how to connect react component to redux
takeaways: Reducers are functions that return a piece of application state; combineReducers merges them into a root reducer (the store's state).
A container is a React component connected to the Redux store via connect(), using mapStateToProps to pick the state it needs as props.
Action creators return objects with a type (required) and payload; mapDispatchToProps with bindActionCreators routes them through all reducers.
Reducers must always return a state value and should ignore action types they do not handle via a default return.
The Provider component wraps the app and makes the store available to all connected components.
summary.summary: The tutorial builds a small contacts app where clicking a name shows that contact's phone number. It walks through the key Redux parts in order: reducers (including a static contacts reducer and an activeContact reducer combined with combineReducers), containers wired with connect and mapStateToProps, and action creators routed via mapDispatchToProps. It then adds a ContactDetail container and shows how the Provider and store are set up in the main file. The example is adapted from Stephen Grider's Udemy course Modern React with Redux and uses the older createStore/applyMiddleware style.
